coverage_override.reason: Link material, conditional targeting protection, attack-announcement summon, and unique-control rule are four distinct records.

effects.lua_implementation: AddLinkProcedure requires exactly one non-Link Shining Brigade monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Link Monsters use aux.AddLinkProcedure with filtered material requirements.

effects.printed_clause: While you control another "Shining Brigade" monster, this card cannot be targeted for attacks or by card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: While another face-up archetype monster is controlled, battle targeting is prohibited and EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET now has value 1, prohibiting either player from targeting this card.

official_references.matched_structure: Official unqualified card-effect targeting protection uses EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET with unconditional value 1 rather than opponent-only aux.tgoval.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: aux.tgoval was opponent-only, while the text's unqualified 'cannot be targeted ... by card effects' applies to both players.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn, when a monster on the field declares an attack: Special Summon 1 "Shining Brigade" monster from your hand or Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: A mandatory soft-once-per-turn EVENT_ATTACK_ANNOUNCE trigger Special Summons one legal archetype monster from hand or Deck.

effects.printed_clause: You can only control 1 "Shining Brigade - Companion Team".
effects.lua_implementation: SetUniqueOnField(1,0,id) enforces one copy on the controller's field.

official_references.matched_structure: Official unique-control text is implemented with SetUniqueOnField.
